title: Completion of a strict henselization is Noetherian and faithfully flat
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, let $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples], and let $\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}}=\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}}$ be the maximal ideal of $R^{\mathrm{sh}}$. Let $\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}=\varprojlim_n R^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak m^{\mathrm{sh}})^n$ be the completion at this ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then $\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}$ is Noetherian and the canonical local map $R^{\mathrm{sh}}\to\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof parts (a) and (c), specialized to the strict henselization

proof.text: Apply the ring-predicate local-structure comparison to hC. It provides IsLocalRing C and maximalIdeal C = I, where I is the extension of the maximal ideal of A. The ideal I is finitely generated since maximalIdeal A is finitely generated and ideal map preserves finite generation. Rewrite C/I as the residue field of C, which is Noetherian. The quotient completion criterion now gives IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion I C).
Use the strict-henselization completion-flatness theorem and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff to obtain Module.Flat C (AdicCompletion I C).

Rewrite I as maximalIdeal C and its finite-generation proof accordingly. Apply Mathlib AdicCompletion.isLocalRing_of_fg and AdicCompletion.algebraMap_isLocalHom_of_fg. These require only finite generation of the maximal ideal, not Noetherianity of C.

Register the flatness, completion locality and local-homomorphism proofs as local instances. Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom (the existing flat-local Mathlib leaf) gives faithful flatness. Assemble the three conjuncts.
